dedupe_keys.name: tree determination routing and spectrum assignment using point to multipoint coherent optics

description: Napoli, Antonio and colleagues document this resource in the B5G-OPEN community. The TRSA heuristic partitions target IP capacity demands into hub-spoke trees, assigns transceivers, routes light trees and allocates spectrum over a physical fibre network. Variants include optional fault tolerance and arbitrary topologies. Coverage is a metro reference scenario evaluated across IP densities and traffic loads. The source reports equipment savings accompanied by greater spectrum occupation. A shorter generalised dimensioning paper is retained as the same method family. Implementation files and complete parameter settings are not established. Zenodo provides the descriptive publication with open access; its stated licence is cc-by-4.0. Its publication licence does not establish a code licence or source-code availability. A limitation is that the native metadata do not establish all implementation settings, uncertainty bounds or independent reproducibility. Only descriptive metadata were inspected. Related records and companion papers retain their source-defined roles; they do not imply independent measurements.
